rule: owner 2026-11-11: animation word added to every duration

rows.before: • 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
rows.after: • 100 Reload Speed with 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration

rows.before: Weapon Kills grant 100 Handling and a 0.825x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier to all weapons for #e${8.5+#d} seconds.
rows.after: Weapon Kills grant 100 Handling and 17.5% decreased Handling Animation Duration to all weapons for #e${8.5+#d} seconds.

rows.before: #e${50+#d} Reload Speed with a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.
rows.after: #e${50+#d} Reload Speed with 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration.

rows.before: Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier for 1 second.
rows.after: Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and 5% decreased Ready Animation Duration for 1 second.

rows.before: Passively decreases Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone Size by 30% and grants a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier.
rows.after: Passively decreases Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone Size by 30% and grants 5% decreased Ready Animation Duration.

rows.before: Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below #e${30+#d}% Shield Health.
rows.after: Grants 50 Handling and 5% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration while at or below #e${30+#d}% Shield Health.

rows.before: Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for #e${6+#d} seconds.
rows.after: Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration for #e${6+#d} seconds.

rows.before: Reload Duration Multiplier scales from 0.9x at 50% capacity to 0.8x with an empty magazine.
rows.after: Reload Animation Duration decreases linearly from 10% at 50% capacity to 20% with an empty magazine.

rows.before: Scoring a Melee Hit grants 15 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and a 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.
rows.after: Scoring a Melee Hit grants 15 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration for 5.25 seconds.

rows.before: Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to #element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
rows.after: Grants 20%|25%|30% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration to #element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

rows.before: Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness, 50 Handling, and a 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier to Submachine Guns (SMGs).
rows.after: Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness, 50 Handling, and 20% decreased Ready/Stow Animation Duration to Submachine Guns (SMGs).

rows.before: Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.
rows.after: Rifts and <solar/>Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.

rows.before: Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.
rows.after: Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.

rows.before: Passively grants 30 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.
rows.after: Passively grants 30 Reload Speed with 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration.
